implemented: Native toolbar DOM selection through CDP Overlay, bounded selected-node JSON attached as .swdomelement; identity, XPath, text, attributes, computed styles, pseudo elements, interaction, ancestry and frame context.
PNG page screenshot captured into the originating chat attachment store; no delivery to a newly selected chat after an asynchronous response.
Ten pinned device presets, custom dimensions/scale/mobile mode, rotation and responsive viewport fit preserving logical CSS dimensions.
Native DevTools action, cancellation on navigation, correlated ten-second CDP deadlines and retirement of stale responses.
regressions: Actual browser fixtures reproduced three reentrant selection/cancellation failures. Operation epochs and QPointer checks now retire old callbacks when observers cancel, replace or delete an operation.
Rotation copies QJsonValue before updating either dimension, avoiding aliased QJsonValueRef values.
limits: Uses the installed WebView2/CDP implementation. Chromium-specific behavior and all source frame navigation cases are not certified equivalent.
React/Vue component ancestry and source-code metadata are not collected; screenshot is a separate PNG attachment, not source per-element WebP capture.
Input value and srcdoc attributes are excluded. Native bounds intentionally limit large DOM captures.
Device metrics can remain applied if touch-emulation setup fails; the UI reports the failure. Full browser/session restoration and every source shortcut remain separate gaps.

finalSharedIntegration.scope: Named suite reports and exact tested source hashes are retained in the final aggregate. Focused/historical evidence above remains scoped to its original observation; full upstream parity is not implied.
